prompt: New hires must be able to use a Dataverse app on their first morning without waiting for an admin to assign a security role individually. Which setup achieves this?

options.text: Create a Microsoft Entra ID group team in the environment, assign it the security role, and have HR add new hires to the Entra group when they're licensed
Create an owner team, assign it the role, and have the team administrator add each new hire manually
Assign every new hire the Environment Maker role by default, which grants app access
Share the app with an access team so members inherit its security role

explanation: Bei Entra-ID-Gruppenteams wird die Mitgliedschaft dynamisch beim Zugriff abgeleitet: Ist die Gruppe mit einem Team verknüpft, das eine Rolle hat, reicht die Aufnahme in die Gruppe plus Lizenz — sofortiger Zugriff ohne Rollenzuweisung durch den Admin. Owner Teams brauchen manuelle Pflege, Environment Maker hat keine Datenrechte, Access Teams haben keine Rollen.

source.title: Configure Dataverse group teams for security
source.quote: When a new user is created in the tenant, all the administrator needs to do is assign the user to the appropriate Microsoft Entra ID group, and assign Dataverse licenses. The user can immediately access the environment without the need to wait for the administrator to assign a security role.

prompt: Members of a group team can read records the team owns, but they can't create records of their own even though the team's role includes Create. The admin doesn't want to assign each member an individual role. What should change?

options.text: Assign the team a security role configured with member's privilege inheritance, so members get User-level privileges as if the role were assigned directly
Change the table's ownership to Organization so team members no longer need Create
Convert the group team to an access team, which grants members full CRUD rights
Add the Environment Admin role to the team so its privileges cascade to members

explanation: Eine Teamrolle ohne Privilegienvererbung gibt Mitgliedern nur Zugriff auf teameigene Datensätze. Sollen Mitglieder eigene Datensätze anlegen und besitzen, ohne eigene Rolle, braucht die Teamrolle „member's privilege inheritance“. Tabellenbesitz ist nach dem Anlegen fix, Access Teams haben keine Rollen.

source.title: Configure Dataverse group teams for security
source.quote: These privileges can't be applied by assigning a nonmember's privilege inherited security role to a team and then adding the user to that team. If you need to provide your team members the team privileges directly, without their own security role, you can assign the team a security role that has member's privilege inheritance.

prompt: An admin plans to secure an environment with a Microsoft Entra ID group whose membership type is Dynamic Device. What will happen?

options.text: It won't work — only Assigned and Dynamic User membership types are supported for group teams
It works, but only for Microsoft 365 groups, not security groups
It works for read access but members can't own records
It works after the group is converted to an owner team

explanation: Für Gruppenteams sind Security- und Microsoft-365-Gruppen mit den Mitgliedschaftstypen Assigned und Dynamic User zulässig. Dynamic Device wird nicht unterstützt — Zugriff hängt an Personen, nicht an Geräten.

source.title: Configure Dataverse group teams for security
source.quote: Both types of Microsoft Entra ID groups, Security and Microsoft 365, with a Membership type Assigned and Dynamic User can be used to secure user-access rights. Membership type Dynamic Device isn't supported.

prompt: A licensed user reports they cannot open the environment. An admin selects Run diagnostics on the user in the Power Platform admin center. Which three checks does it perform? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.text: The user is enabled for sign-in in Microsoft Entra ID
The user is a member of the environment's Microsoft Entra ID group
The user has at least one Dataverse security role, directly or via a group team
The user's device is enrolled in Intune
The user has published at least one app in the environment

explanation: Run diagnostics prüft vier Dinge: Sign-in in Entra ID aktiviert, gültige Lizenz, Mitgliedschaft in der Entra-Gruppe der Umgebung und mindestens eine Dataverse-Sicherheitsrolle (direkt oder über ein Gruppenteam). Geräte-Enrollment und App-Veröffentlichung gehören nicht dazu.

source.title: Check the roles that a user belongs to
source.quote: Is enabled for sign-in in Microsoft Entra ID. Has a valid license. Is a member of the environment's Microsoft Entra ID group? Has at least one Dataverse security role assigned directly to them or to a group team they're a member of.

prompt: A manager can see a specific Opportunity row that, by role, they shouldn't have access to. A maker needs to find out whether the access comes from ownership, a role, sharing, or hierarchy security — for that exact row. Which tool?

options.text: Access Checker in the model-driven app command bar
Run diagnostics in the Power Platform admin center
The Audit Summary View
The Solution Checker

explanation: Access Checker zeigt für eine konkrete Zeile, woher der Zugriff eines Nutzers stammt: Besitz, Sicherheitsrolle, Freigabe oder Hierarchie. Run diagnostics prüft nur den Umgebungszugang, das Audit zeigt Änderungen, der Solution Checker prüft Lösungen.

source.title: Check the roles that a user belongs to
source.quote: Within a model-driven app you can use Access Checker in the command bar to see the privileges a user has for a table row. Access checker defaults to your user, but you can select another user to see their privileges on the row.

topic: ALM: solutions as the unit of deployment
prompt: A maker built a canvas app directly from the Apps list (outside any solution) and now wants to deploy it to test and production with Power Platform pipelines. What must happen first?

options.text: Add the app to a solution — apps built outside a solution can't be deployed as part of a structured release process
Publish the app; pipelines deploy the latest published version of any app
Export the app as a .msapp file and import it in each environment
Share the app with the pipeline's service principal as co-owner

explanation: Solutions sind der Verpackungsmechanismus für Apps und ihre Komponenten. Außerhalb einer Solution gebaute Apps haben nur eingeschränkten ALM-Support und können nicht über Pipelines ausgerollt werden. Also erst in eine Solution aufnehmen.

source.title: Application lifecycle management
source.quote: Apps built outside a solution have limited ALM support; they can't be deployed as part of a structured release process.

prompt: A development team wants branching and pull requests for their Power Platform solutions alongside pipeline deployments, without leaving the Microsoft ecosystem. Which capability does the guidance point to?

options.text: Power Platform Git integration
The Center of Excellence Starter Kit
Managed Environments
Dataverse auditing

explanation: Für professionelles ALM mit Quellcodeverwaltung synchronisiert die Power Platform Git-Integration Solutions in ein Git-Repository, sodass Teams Branching und Pull Requests zusammen mit Pipelines nutzen können.

source.title: Application lifecycle management
source.quote: For professional ALM with source control, explore Power Platform Git integration, which lets you sync solutions to a Git repository so teams can use branching and pull requests alongside pipelines.

prompt: A consultant inherits a managed expense-management solution and wants to document it by creating a plan from the solution. For each statement, select Yes if it is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: The generated plan is saved into a new unmanaged solution, because managed solutions can't be modified directly.
The solution needs at least one app and one associated table for Plans to generate a meaningful document.
Creating a plan from the environment's default solution is the recommended way to document everything at once.

explanation: Bei verwalteten Lösungen landet der Plan in einer neuen unverwalteten Lösung; unverwaltete Lösungen nehmen den Plan direkt auf. Ohne mindestens eine App und eine Tabelle entsteht kein sinnvolles Dokument. Von der Default-Lösung wird abgeraten — sie mischt zu viele unzusammenhängende Komponenten.

source.title: Create a plan from an existing solution
source.quote: Managed solution: The plan saves in a new unmanaged solution by default, since managed solutions can't be modified directly. The solution needs at least one app and one associated table for plans to generate a meaningful document. Creating a plan from a default solution isn't recommended because default solutions contain a broad mix of components that may not represent a single coherent business process.

prompt: A maker with the Environment Maker role tries to create a Power Pages site in a Dataverse environment and the option fails. What is required?

options.text: The System Administrator role in the selected Dataverse environment
A Power Pages Per User license assigned to the maker
The Basic User role plus a Power Automate premium license
Co-owner rights on at least one canvas app in the environment

explanation: Das Bereitstellen einer Site setzt die Rolle System Administrator in der gewählten Dataverse-Umgebung voraus. Die Site entsteht zunächst immer als Trial und kann später in eine Produktions-Site umgewandelt werden.

source.title: Get started with Power Pages
source.quote: To provision a site, you must be assigned to the System Administrator role in the Dataverse environment selected for the site. A Power Pages site is always created as a trial that can later be converted to a production site.

prompt: The Power Pages Security workspace is organized into three sections. Match each task to the section where it lives.

left.text: Run a security scan for common vulnerabilities
Configure web roles, page permissions, table permissions, and the Web Application Firewall
Configure identity providers, site visibility, CSP and CORS settings

explanation: Monitor enthält den Security Scan. Protect bündelt Zugriffssteuerung auf Inhalte und Daten — Web Roles, Page- und Table-Permissions, WAF. Manage regelt den Zugang zur Site selbst: Identitätsanbieter, Sichtbarkeit und erweiterte Einstellungen wie CSP/CORS.

source.title: Secure your Power Pages site
source.quote: The Security workspace is organized into three sections: Monitor, Protect, and Manage. The Monitor section includes the Security scan tool, which analyzes your site for common vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. The Manage section provides settings for controlling access to the site itself

prompt: A public knowledge page must be readable by visitors who never sign in, while the case-submission page requires authentication. How is access to the public page granted?

options.text: Apply the Anonymous Users web role in the page permissions — web roles can be applied to unauthenticated users that way
Set site visibility to Private and share the page URL externally
Create a local sign-in account named Guest and share its password
Remove all table permissions from the page so it renders without a role

explanation: Web Roles gelten für authentifizierte Nutzer, lassen sich über die Rolle „Anonymous Users“ aber auch auf nicht angemeldete Besucher anwenden. Seitenberechtigungen können auf „Allow everyone“ oder auf bestimmte Web Roles beschränkt werden. Private Sites verlangen immer eine Anmeldung.

source.title: Secure your Power Pages site
source.quote: Web roles are assigned to authenticated users or can be applied to unauthenticated users via the Anonymous Users role. Pages can be set to Allow everyone to see this page or restricted to specific web roles.

prompt: A designer wants a custom style applied to one landing page only, without affecting the site theme. Which approach matches the guidance?

options.text: Open the page with Edit code in Visual Studio Code for the Web and change its CSS file — those changes apply to the selected page only
Upload a custom CSS file in the Styling workspace — uploaded files apply per page by default
Generate a new theme with Copilot and assign it to the landing page
Create a page template in the Portal Management app; templates carry their own scoped styles

explanation: Hochgeladene CSS-Dateien im Styling-Workspace gelten für alle Themes und die ganze Site. Für seitenspezifische Styles öffnet man die Seite per Edit code — dort laden HTML, CSS und JavaScript der Seite, und CSS-Änderungen wirken nur auf diese Seite.

source.title: Site styling and templates
source.quote: Once you upload the custom CSS file, it applies to all themes, and the page canvas reflects the applicable styles. When you open a page in the editor, three files load: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Any changes in the CSS file apply to the selected page only.

prompt: A Power Pages form needs complex client-side validation and must call an external web service before submission. Which extensibility option fits, and what caveat applies?

options.text: Custom JavaScript embedded in the page or form — noting that Power Pages scripts don't reuse model-driven app form scripts
A business rule on the Dataverse table, which runs identically in Power Pages forms
A Liquid template, since Liquid executes on the client and can call web services
Reuse the model-driven app's OnSave JavaScript web resource, which Power Pages loads automatically

explanation: Für komplexe Eingabevalidierung und Web-Service-Aufrufe im Browser ist eingebettetes JavaScript vorgesehen. Wichtig: Skripte in Power Pages sind eigenständig und nutzen nicht die Formularskripte modellgesteuerter Apps. Liquid rendert serverseitig dynamischen Inhalt, Business Rules laufen nicht in Portalformularen.

source.title: Overview of Power Pages extensibility
source.quote: JavaScript can be used to enhance client interface, add complex user input validation, call external web services, or access Dataverse functionality directly using the Power Pages Web API. Scripting on website pages is specific to Power Pages and does not use scripts from model-driven apps in forms or views.

prompt: An admin needs a role that is almost identical to Basic User but with two extra privileges on a custom table. What is the recommended way to create it?

options.text: Copy the Basic User role and modify the copy — standard roles can't be edited directly
Edit the Basic User role directly and add the privileges
Create a blank custom role and re-enter every Basic User privilege
Assign Basic User plus System Customizer to cover the extra privileges

explanation: Vordefinierte Rollen lassen sich nicht direkt ändern, aber kopieren. Eine Kopie zu erweitern ist deutlich einfacher als eine leere Rolle nachzubauen — Standardrollen bringen die Verknüpfung zu den Standardtabellen bereits mit. System Customizer wäre viel zu weitreichend.

source.title: Exercise - Create a custom role
source.quote: Roles can be copied so you can quickly create similar roles that might be slightly different. Also, it is much easier to copy a role and modify it, than to generate one from nothing.
